description: This file defines the ViewsFormMainForm class for Drupal, implementing form handling for Views, including rendering, substitution, validation, and submission logic.

classes.name: ViewsFormMainForm
classes.description: Main form class for Drupal Views, handling form rendering, processing, and substitution logic.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the form ID, currently an empty string.

methods.name: preRenderViewsForm
methods.description: Prepares the form element by replacing substitution placeholders with actual rendered content and safe substitutions.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns an array of callback method names that are trusted for rendering.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the Drupal form array, adding elements, actions, and handling substitutions and area handlers.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form by invoking validation methods on view fields and area handlers.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission by invoking submit methods on view fields and area handlers.
